blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: «In expressions answering the questions „How long?“ and „How long ago?“ the accusative case is used: Я был там год. Я был там месяц. Я был там неделю.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. «2, 3, 4 + Gen. sing.; 5 and up + Gen. plur.»: «After три and четыре… the noun is also in the genitive singular… After all other numerals (пять, шесть, семь, etc.)… the noun is in the genitive plural.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 39.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: “How long?” — the accusative, with no preposition. (DLI, Lesson 41)
